user_saw: A long proxied model response failed once its stream exceeded 16 MiB, even when each event was small.
summary: The fix applies the 16 MiB limit to each pending SSE line instead of counting bytes across the entire proxy stream.
reasoning: The July 1 snapshot already passed a 16 MiB limit to a guard that added every chunk to a running total. The October refactor kept the guard and changed how read timeouts were handled. The available offline history stops before the cap was introduced, so I could not establish whether proxy streaming originally shipped with it or acquired it later.
